description: This source file defines the CameraRefocus class, which manages camera focusing behavior in a Unity project. It includes methods for changing the camera and parent transform, obtaining focus points via raycasting, and setting the camera to focus on a particular point.

classes.name: CameraRefocus
classes.description: A class that manages camera refocusing functionality, including changing camera target, parent transform, and focusing on detected points.

methods.name: CameraRefocus
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the camera refocusing object with a camera, parent transform, and original camera position.

methods.name: ChangeCamera
methods.description: Method to update the current camera used by this class.

methods.name: ChangeParent
methods.description: Method to update the parent transform used for calculating focus points.

methods.name: GetFocusPoint
methods.description: Performs a raycast to determine the focus point based on the current parent position and direction.

methods.name: SetFocusPoint
methods.description: Adjusts the camera to look at the previously obtained focus point if refocusing is enabled.
